title: 裁剪数字后查询第 K 小的下标
summary: 等长数字字符串数组中，每个查询取所有字符串末尾 trim 位作为数字，按数值及原下标稳定排序，返回第 k 小的原下标。
insight: 长度相同且可能有前导零，所以裁剪串的字典序就是数值序。每个查询排序下标，比较对应后缀，后缀相同时比较原下标。
pitfalls: 相等裁剪值按较小原下标优先

solutions.title: 逐查询排序下标
solutions.idea: 直接按固定长度后缀与下标排序。
steps: 后缀相同按 index 升序

code.java: class Solution { public int[] smallestTrimmedNumbers(String[] nums,int[][] queries){int[] answer=new int[queries.length];int length=nums[0].length();for(int q=0;q<queries.length;q++){int trim=queries[q][1];Integer[] indices=new Integer[nums.length];for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++)indices[i]=i;Arrays.sort(indices,(a,b)->{int compare=nums[a].substring(length-trim).compareTo(nums[b].substring(length-trim));return compare!=0?compare:Integer.compare(a,b);});answer[q]=indices[queries[q][0]-1];}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun smallestTrimmedNumbers(nums:Array<String>,queries:Array<IntArray>):IntArray{val length=nums[0].length;return IntArray(queries.size){q->val k=queries[q][0];val trim=queries[q][1];val indices=nums.indices.sortedWith(compareBy<Int>{nums[it].substring(length-trim)}.thenBy{it});indices[k-1]}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<int> smallestTrimmedNumbers(vector<string>& nums,vector<vector<int>>& queries){vector<int> answer;int length=nums[0].size();for(auto& query:queries){int trim=query[1];vector<int> indices(nums.size());iota(indices.begin(),indices.end(),0);sort(indices.begin(),indices.end(),[&](int a,int b){string first=nums[a].substr(length-trim),second=nums[b].substr(length-trim);return first==second?a<b:first<second;});answer.push_back(indices[query[0]-1]);}return answer;} };
